title: PIQI Rubric
description: Schema describing a PIQI scoring rubric: a versioned, authority-aligned set of criteria evaluated against entities in a referenced PIQI clinical model, used to score data quality.

mnemonic.description: Short, unique, upper-case code identifying the rubric.

tenantUid.description: UUID of the tenant that owns this rubric.

description.description: Free-text description of the rubric's purpose and scope.

version.description: Rubric version, typically encoded as a date-like integer (e.g., YYYYMM).

authorityName.description: Name of the standards authority or program the rubric is aligned to.

model.description: Reference to the PIQI clinical model this rubric's criteria are evaluated against.

name.description: Human-readable name of the referenced model.

mnemonic.description: Mnemonic code of the referenced model.

version.description: Version number of the referenced model.

source.description: The organization or body that published/maintains this rubric.

name.description: Human-readable name of the source organization.

mnemonic.description: Mnemonic code of the source organization.

criteria.description: The ordered set of scoring criteria that make up the rubric.

samParameter.description: A named parameter value passed to a Scoring Algorithm Method (SAM), configuring how it evaluates the target entity.

samParameterMnemonic.description: Mnemonic code identifying which SAM parameter this is.

parameterValue.description: The value supplied for the parameter. May be a single value or a comma-separated list depending on parameterValueTypeName.

parameterValueTypeName.description: The data/value type of the parameter, indicating how parameterValue should be interpreted.

parameterName.description: Human-readable display name of the parameter.

criterion.description: A single scoring criterion: a Scoring Algorithm Method (SAM) applied to a target entity/attribute, optionally gated by a conditional SAM.

sequence.description: Ordering position of the criterion within the rubric.

description.description: Free-text description of the criterion. May be empty string or null when not provided.

entity.description: Mnemonic of the model attribute/entity this criterion evaluates.

samMnemonic.description: Mnemonic identifying the Scoring Algorithm Method (SAM) used to evaluate the entity.

samNameOverride.description: Human-readable label describing the passing condition of this criterion, shown in scorecards.

failureNameOverride.description: Human-readable label describing the failing condition of this criterion, shown in scorecards.
examples: allergy reaction is not SNOMED CT

conditionalSam.description: Mnemonic of a SAM that must evaluate true before this criterion is scored (e.g., only score if the attribute is populated). Null if the criterion is unconditional.

scoringEffect.description: How this criterion affects the overall score.

scoringWeight.description: Relative weight applied to this criterion's contribution to the overall score.

criticalityIndicator.description: Whether failing this criterion is considered a critical (high-severity) failure.

samParameters.description: Parameters configuring the primary SAM referenced by samMnemonic.

conditionalSamParameters.description: Parameters configuring the conditional SAM referenced by conditionalSam.
